cx001.e: しめる: to close. It's cold, so "close the window".
cx001.t: It's cold, so please close the window.

cx002.e: つける: to turn on (the light).
cx002.t: It's dark, isn't it? Let's turn on the light.

cx003.t: I don't know how to read this hiragana. I'll ask the teacher.

cx004.t: It's hot, isn't it? I want to drink some cold juice.

cx005.t: It's raining, so I'll take an umbrella.

cx006.e: めがねを かける: to wear glasses.
cx006.t: My eyesight is bad, so I wear glasses.

cx007.e: ゆうびんきょく: post office.
cx007.t: I'm going to the post office to send a letter.

cx008.t: I'm going to the library to borrow a book.

cx009.t: I have a headache, so I'm going to the hospital.

cx010.t: This room is spacious and bright.

cx011.t: This apple is sweet and delicious.

cx012.t: I have a lot of work today, so I'm busy.

cx013.e: ひま: free, with nothing to do.
cx013.t: I'm free on Sunday, so let's hang out together.

cx014.e: しずかに する: to be quiet.
cx014.t: Please be quiet in the library.

cx015.t: This road has a lot of cars and is dangerous.

cx016.e: ちかい: near. That's why they walk.
cx016.t: My house is near the station, so I walk there every day.

cx017.t: This bag has lots of books in it, so it's heavy.

cx018.e: あまい: sweet. With sugar, "I made it sweet".
cx018.t: I put sugar in my coffee to make it sweet.

cx019.e: かぜが つよく ふく: the wind blows hard.
cx019.t: The wind was blowing hard yesterday.

cx020.t: This pen is pretty. How much was it?

cx021.e: ねる: to go to bed, sleep.
cx021.t: I go to bed at 11 every night.

cx022.t: I get up at 6 in the morning and take a shower.

cx023.t: Before getting on the train, I buy a ticket.

cx024.e: かりる: to borrow. "I'll return it tomorrow."
cx024.t: I borrowed a dictionary from a friend. I'll return it tomorrow.

cx025.t: I lent Tanaka a pen, because he didn't have one.

cx026.e: セーターを きる: to put on a sweater (upper body).
cx026.t: It's cold today, so please put on a sweater.

cx027.e: くつを ぬぐ: to take off your shoes.
cx027.t: Please take off your shoes before entering the room.

cx028.e: くつを はく: to put on shoes.
cx028.t: I went out wearing my new shoes.

cx029.e: ぼうしを かぶる: to put on a hat.
cx029.t: It's hot, so please wear a hat.

cx030.e: 〜に のる: to get on/in a vehicle.

cx031.e: 〜を おりる: to get off (the train).
cx031.t: I get off the train at the next station.

cx033.e: ならべる: to line up, set out (the plates).
cx033.t: Please set the plates out on the table.

cx034.e: シャワーを あびる: to take a shower.
cx034.t: I take a shower every morning.

cx035.e: てを あらう: to wash your hands.
cx035.t: I wash my hands before meals.

cx036.e: はを みがく: to brush your teeth.
cx036.t: I brush my teeth before going to bed.

cx037.e: かみを きる: to cut your hair.
cx037.t: My hair got long, so I cut it.

cx038.e: ピアノを ひく: to play the piano.

cx039.e: しゃしんを とる: to take a photo.

cx040.e: およぐ: to swim (in the sea).
cx040.t: I swam in the sea during the summer holidays.

cx041.t: The Japanese test is easy. I finished it in 30 minutes.

cx042.t: That teacher is kind, so everyone likes him.

cx043.t: This town has a lot of people and is lively.

cx044.t: That restaurant is famous. There's always a line of people.

cx045.t: I don't like fish, so I don't eat it.

cx046.e: じょうず: skilled, good at.
cx046.t: My father is good at cooking. He makes delicious meals every day.

cx048.e: 〜まい: counter for flat objects (stamps, paper).

cx050.e: 〜さつ: counter for books and notebooks.

cx051.e: 〜だい: counter for machines and vehicles.
cx051.t: We have two cars at home.

cx052.e: 〜ひき (さんびき): counter for small animals.
cx052.t: There were three dogs in the park.

cx054.t: I have been to Japan twice.

cx055.e: でんわばんごう: phone number.

cx056.t: Please send the letter in this envelope.

cx057.t: I cut the meat with a knife.

cx058.t: You eat soup with a spoon.

cx059.t: Let's take the elevator to the second floor.

cx060.t: It's cold, so let's turn on the heater.

cx061.t: I want to listen to music, so please turn on the radio.

cx062.t: I took a photo with the camera.

cx063.t: The room is hot, so let's open the window.

cx064.t: Please put the milk in the fridge.

cx065.t: I waited 30 minutes for my friend at the station.

cx066.e: むすこ: son. At 3 years old, it can only be the son.

cx067.t: My father's father is my grandfather.

cx068.t: My mother's younger brother is my uncle.

cx069.e: いもうと: younger sister. If she has two older sisters, she is the youngest.
cx069.t: I have two older sisters. I am the younger sister.

cx070.e: わすれもの: something left behind. "I went to pick up what I forgot."
cx070.t: Yesterday I went to school to pick up something I had left behind.

cx071.e: かいものを する: to go shopping.
cx071.t: I went shopping at the department store and got tired.

cx072.t: I have a lot of homework today, so I have no time to watch TV.

cx073.t: Please have a seat on this chair.

cx074.e: みちが わからない: to not know the way.
cx074.t: Where is the post office? I don't know the way.

cx075.e: たばこを すう: to smoke.

cx076.t: I don't have my key. I lost it somewhere.

cx077.e: さらを あらう: to wash the dishes.
cx077.t: I ate and washed the dishes.

cx078.e: がっこうを やすむ: to stay home from school.
cx078.t: I'm sick, so I'm staying home from school today.

cx079.e: おぼえる: to memorize, learn.
cx079.t: I want to learn a lot of kanji.

cx080.e: しつもんに こたえる: to answer a question.

cx081.e: つかれる: to get tired.
cx081.t: I walked a lot and got tired.

cx082.e: はれる: to clear up, be sunny.
cx082.t: The sky was clear this morning. The weather was nice.

cx083.e: あめが やむ: the rain stops.
cx083.t: When the rain stops, let's play outside.

cx084.e: はなが さく: to bloom.
cx084.t: When spring comes, the cherry trees bloom.

cx085.t: I wrote a letter to a friend who lives in Japan.

cx086.e: 〜に つとめる: to work for (a company). With に, はたらいて doesn't fit: it would be "で はたらいて".
cx086.t: My older brother works for a bank.

cx087.e: はじまる (intransitive): to begin. はじめる needs an object with を.
cx087.t: Classes start at 9. And they end at 12.

cx088.t: The children are playing in the park.

cx089.e: じしょを ひく: to look up in a dictionary.
cx089.t: Please look up words you don't know in the dictionary.

cx090.e: よく: well, a lot. あまり/ぜんぜん go with a negative.
cx090.t: There's a test tomorrow, so I'll study hard.

cx091.e: ぜんぜん 〜ない: not at all.
cx091.t: I don't like fish, so I never eat it.

cx093.t: Have you finished your homework yet?

cx094.e: まだ 〜て いません: not yet.

cx095.e: ちょうど ３じ: exactly 3 o'clock. ごろ and ぐらい go after the number.
cx095.t: The movie starts at exactly 3 o'clock.

cx096.e: ゆっくり: slowly. Because it's dangerous.
cx096.t: It's dangerous, so please run slowly.

cx097.t: There's no time. Please come quickly.

cx098.t: I usually get up at 7, but today I got up at 9.

cx099.e: はじめて: for the first time.
cx099.t: This is my first time coming to Japan.

cx100.e: いかがですか: how about…?, a polite offer.
cx100.t: Would you like another cup of coffee?

cx101.e: どうして: why. The answer gives a reason (〜から).
cx101.t: "Why are you studying Japanese?" "Because I use it at work."

cx104.t: "Who is that person over there?" "That's Mr. Yamada."

cx105.t: My room is on the 5th floor of this building.

cx106.e: ワンピースを きる: to wear a dress. (With ネクタイ the verb would be する.)
cx106.t: I'll wear a dress to tomorrow's party.

cx107.t: During the summer holidays I went on a trip with friends.

cx108.e: ねつが ある: to have a fever.
cx108.t: Tanaka has a fever because of a cold.

cx109.t: There is a bus stop in front of my house.

cx110.e: はしを わたる: to cross a bridge.
cx110.t: Please cross this bridge and turn right.

cx111.e: かどを まがる: to turn at a corner.
cx111.t: Please turn left at the next corner.

cx112.t: Summer is hot, so I often swim in the sea.

cx113.t: Winter is cold, so I don't like it much.

cx114.e: あめが ふる: to rain.
cx114.t: It's raining outside, so I'll take an umbrella.

cx115.e: The reply to いってきます is いってらっしゃい.

cx116.e: いただきます: said before eating.

cx117.e: The reply to ただいま is おかえりなさい.

cx118.e: スポーツ: sports. Soccer is a sport.
cx118.t: I like sports. I especially watch a lot of soccer.

cx119.e: かぎを かける: to lock.
cx119.t: I lock my room before going out.

cx120.t: Please put this letter in the mailbox.

cx121.e: とても + affirmative. あまり/ぜんぜん need a negative.
cx121.t: Yesterday I saw a movie with a friend, and it was very interesting.

cx122.t: This park is large and has a lot of trees.

cx123.t: I watched the news on TV and found out tomorrow's weather.

cx124.t: Please make 5 copies of the meeting documents.

cx125.e: さんぽする: to take a walk.
cx125.t: I take a walk in the park every morning.

cx126.t: This water is dirty, so please don't drink it.

cx127.t: I stayed up late last night, so I'm very sleepy today.

cx128.e: かいだんを のぼる: to go up the stairs.
cx128.t: I went up the stairs to the second floor.

cx129.e: みちを わたる: to cross the road.
cx129.t: When the light turns green, please cross the road.

cx130.e: いれる: to put in (the mailbox).
cx130.t: Please put this letter in the mailbox.

cx131.t: I wrote the new words in my notebook.

cx132.t: It's hot, isn't it? Please take off your shirt.

cx133.e: 〜から もらう: to receive from.
cx133.t: I got flowers from a friend on my birthday.

cx134.e: あげる: to give (I give to someone).
cx134.t: I gave my old books to my younger sister.

cx135.t: My mother gave me a sweater.

cx136.e: わすれる: to forget, leave behind.
cx136.t: I left my umbrella on the train.

cx137.t: When you press this button, the door opens.

cx138.t: The wind is strong, so please close the window.

cx139.e: ついて いる: to be on.
cx139.t: The light is on. Who turned it on?

cx140.e: ねつが でる: to get a fever.
cx140.t: I caught a cold and got a fever.

cx141.e: は: tooth. That's why they can't eat.
cx141.t: My tooth hurts, so I can't eat.

cx142.t: It snowed, and everything outside turned white.

cx143.t: The garden is big, so children can play there.

cx144.t: I wash the dishes in the kitchen.

cx145.t: I talked with a friend while drinking coffee at a café.

cx146.t: I withdrew money at the bank.

cx147.t: In the Japanese winter, February is the coldest.

cx148.t: When spring comes, the cherry trees bloom.

cx149.t: Today is Sunday, so the office is closed.

cx150.t: Every morning I watch TV and check the weather.

cx151.e: でんきを つける: to turn on the light.
cx151.t: The room is dark, so let's turn on the light.

cx152.t: I take the elevator to the 5th floor.

cx153.t: This bed is very soft, so I sleep well.

cx154.t: Do you put sugar in your coffee?

cx155.t: I get up around 7 every morning.

cx156.t: It takes about 20 minutes to walk to the station.

cx157.e: よく できた: it went well.
cx157.t: I did well on the test. I got 100 points.

cx158.t: I can already write all the hiragana.

cx159.e: もうすこし: a little more.
cx159.t: The train isn't coming. Let's wait a little longer.

cx160.t: When class is over, I go straight home.

cx161.t: I sometimes cook. About once a week.

cx162.t: My older brother is always busy, so we rarely see each other.

cx163.e: おなまえは なんですか.

cx164.t: "Who did you go with?" "I went with a friend."

cx165.t: "When are you going back?" "I'm going back next week."

cx166.t: Please cut this cake into four pieces.

cx167.t: My clothes got wet in the rain.

cx168.e: おくる: to see someone off, take someone to.
cx168.t: I took my friend to the station.

cx169.t: This kanji is easy, so I learned it right away.

cx170.t: I was absent from school for three days because I was sick.

cx172.t: Writing letters in Japanese is difficult.

cx173.t: This book is easy, so even children can read it.

cx174.t: That person is very cheerful. They're always smiling.

cx175.t: This knife cuts well, so it's dangerous.

cx176.t: I have a lot of luggage, so I'll go home by taxi.

cx177.t: This road is narrow, so cars can't get through.

cx178.e: つめたい: cold (to the touch).
cx178.t: It's hot, so I want something cold to drink.

cx179.e: Tricky one: あつい (厚い), thick.
cx179.t: In winter I go out wearing a thick coat.

cx180.t: "Excuse me, where is the restroom?" "Next to those stairs over there."
